```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_standardized_scores
title: >
  New Scores
questions:
  - id: transformed_standard_score
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      A score has $z = -1$. It is transformed to a reporting scale with mean 100 and
      standard deviation 15. What is the transformed score?
    options:
      - text: >
          99
      - text: >
          -15
      - text: >
          85
        correct: true
      - text: >
          115
    explanation: >
      Multiply by the new standard deviation, then add the new mean:
      $15 \times (-1) + 100 = 85$. The score is still one standard deviation
      below the mean.
```
